description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Awoken Earth], [Damage Cap +10000], [King of Bal Mode] and [Baldesion Assault Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Earth
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: King of Bal Mode
description.text: Grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] to the user after using three Earth abilities, removed after triggering

description.name: Baldesion Assault Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Baldesion Assault after using three Earth abilities

description.name: Baldesion Assault
description.text: One single attack (5.28) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate
